transcription.notes: Contributed by WAINUT (27 Oct 2026). Read from the full-resolution NLA images (7617 x 6692 px); figures and glosses re-read independently by a second reader, who agreed digit for digit and resolved one uncertain figure (C12, 4th figure: 6). Measured with docs/_check_profile.py --measure --drop-first --width 1.

conditions.human_role: Posed the problem by pasting the catalogue 598 brief; no target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Archivportal-D blocked by a bot check; Arcinsys ids from the DDB Solr index, METS and the fixed image URL pattern from the in-app browser; page counts of all ten files from thumbnails.
Paged through Nr. 97 (all), 964 (all), 379, 563 and 1130 (images 5-8): every cipher run seen carries an interlinear decipherment; outgoing drafts are clear with the enciphered passages underlined.
Nr. 964 f. 6 (rescript 6/17 Dec 1734): figures, interlinear decipherment and clear text transcribed line by line (texts/964_f6.txt); reading written (texts/964_f6_reading.md).
System from figures vs decipherment on f. 6: about 137 figures for about 120 plaintext letters, so a syllable/word code, not a letter cipher. Group boundaries not recovered.

WAINUT contribution: all 19 images of Nr. 964 fetched at 3600 px with the fixed URL pattern; a second cipher piece found on images 009-010 (ff. 8r-8v, Erffa's P.S. 13, Vienna 18 Dec 1734), not listed in NOTES. Images 004 and 011-018 looked clear (not re-checked independently).

WAINUT contribution: ff. 8r-8v transcribed line by line from full-resolution images: 16 runs, 461 figures, the interlinear decipherment over 13 runs, and the clear text (wainut/964_f8.txt); re-read independently, digit for digit; one uncertain figure resolved, one left uncertain.

WAINUT contribution: reading from the contemporary decipherment written as German sentences with holes marked, and an English translation (wainut/964_f8_reading.md, 964_f8_translation.md). Five stretches of figures with a stroke above them (BAR1, BAR2, BAR3, tails of C5 and C12) have no decipherment and stay open.

WAINUT contribution: repeats in the figures against the glosses (wainut/repeats.py): 2653313571 only in C1 and C13 (both 'von Knörre'), 2653313 in C1, C13 and C7 ('Grafen von Metsch'), 2159826533 in C13 and the barred BAR2; no shuffle of the figures within runs (N=2000) gives a shared string longer than 8. f. 8 shares no 5-figure string with f. 6.
WAINUT contribution: one web search (Reichshofrat Knorr 1734, Erffa, Bartenstein, Contingent) found no printed edition of the report and no identification of 'von Knörre'.

outcome.method_basis: In progress: the passages were deciphered at the time (interlinear decipherments). One passage (964 f. 6) transcribed and read from its decipherment; the rest not yet transcribed, so the method stays 'not solved' until they are, then 'read from existing decipherment'.

texts.label: George II to the Privy Council in Hanover, St James 6/17 Dec 1734
texts.summary: Approves what the Council wrote to Erffa in Vienna and von Haus: the Mecklenburg Reich contingent should not be raised by the King of Prussia. The ciphered clause is deciphered between the lines.

texts.label: Erffa to George II, P.S. 13, Vienna 18 Dec 1734
texts.summary: Hanover's envoy in Vienna reports that the Aulic Councillor von Knörre will help, and will put to Vice-Chancellor Count Metsch and Bartenstein that Mecklenburg should pay the Emperor a sum of money instead of raising its contingent for the Reich army (War of the Polish Succession). The names and the money proposal are in cipher, deciphered between the lines at the time; five barred stretches of figures carry no decipherment.
texts.note: Contributed by WAINUT (27 Oct 2026). Read from the contemporary interlinear decipherment; no key exists, so not checked group by group. The barred stretches (BAR1, BAR2, BAR3 and the tails of C5 and C12, about 72 of 461 figures) are not deciphered on the page.
